task: Installing a new toilet paper holder
query: How do I install a new toilet paper holder?

goal.title: Replace the toilet paper dispenser with a wall holder
goal.description: Unscrew and remove the existing silver dispenser, place it on the floor, and initially position a gold-coloured single-arm holder using a manual screwdriver and a thin screwdriver at its joint. Use a cordless driver, remove the holder again and rest it on the toilet tank. Drill the exposed wall mounting hole, open the anchor case and drive a white anchor into the wall. Retrieve and position the holder, fasten it with the cordless driver, check the joint and repeatedly rework the mounting fasteners, briefly realigning the fixture. Release the holder and turn back toward the tools.
goal.final_state: The replacement gold-coloured holder remains on the wall without a toilet paper roll. The old silver dispenser is on the floor; tools and anchor case remain by the sink. Long-term mounting strength is not established.

procedure.description: Steady the silver dispenser, use the manual screwdriver to undo its two mounting screws, pull it away and handle its back. Lower it onto the floor beside the toilet and leave the screwdriver on the counter.

Collect the gold-coloured single-arm holder, align it against the wall, start its screw by hand and turn it repeatedly with the screwdriver. Inspect its joint and work the underside fastener with a thin screwdriver, then lower the tool to the counter.
Pick up the cordless driver and work the holder fastener. Withdraw the driver, lift the holder away, place the holder on the toilet tank and put the driver on the counter.

Take the twist-bit drill, carry it to the wall and repeatedly drill at the mounting position. Check the hole, put the drill down, open the plastic anchor case, take a white anchor and leave the case on the counter.

Take the cordless driver, align the white anchor with its bit and repeatedly drive the anchor into the wall. Set the driver down, retrieve the holder from the toilet tank, handle its fastener, align it against the wall and retrieve the driver.
Use the cordless driver on the supported holder, release the fixture, lower the tool and return attention to the mounted arm. Adjust the small fastener beneath the arm with both hands.

Bring the cordless driver back to the holder. Work the upper and lower mounting fasteners repeatedly, change the supporting grip, withdraw the driver to inspect the base and briefly lift and realign the holder before continuing. Finally withdraw the driver, touch and release the holder, and turn toward the counter.
